_readme: Machine-readable inputs for wx_path_to_4k.py. Edit values here (or replace this whole file with a refreshed version) to update the model -- the script never needs code changes to pick up new numbers. Every leaf carries a 'quality' tag: MEASURED (directly counted from a live/committed data file this session), BACKTEST (walk-forward/historical study, in-sample), or ASSUMED (a repo constant, a docstring claim, or an extrapolation with no/thin direct measurement -- gets a wide uncertainty multiplier in the model and must render as visibly flagged in output).

win_rate.note: Phase-2 Track A deployable win rate 99.6%, Wilson95 LB cited elsewhere ~99.2-99.4%. Conservative uses the Wilson lower bound family.

avg_loser_magnitude_usd_per_ct.note: kwx_sizing.py docstring cites real per-fire losses of -1.0 and -0.77 $/ct; 0.88 is their mean. Used only to split ev_per_ct into a win/loss magnitude pair for variance -- the MEAN pnl per contract is always pinned to ev_per_ct below, this value only shapes the spread.

ev_per_ct_usd.note: Deployable taker edge net of fees. +0.207 is in-sample/act-at-cross (Phase-2 Track A, t=37). +0.15-0.17 is the realistic-latency (2-5min) haircut -- what the live runner without book-watch actually captures. book_watch sleeve (below) interpolates a fire's captured EV back toward the +0.207 ceiling.

exec_price.note: Used only for Kelly-fraction and contract-count/depth conversion (budget / price), decoupled from the win/loss pnl model above to avoid double-counting the edge. Sampled from a triangular distribution with mode=median (was uniform[low,high], which silently ignored the median parameter and inflated contracts-per-budget ~17% wherever budget-bound -- judge review finding #6). Per-fire win magnitude is also now capped at the physical maximum gross payout (1-price) so no simulated fire can win more per contract than a YES/NO settlement can possibly pay, even though the SCENARIO-MEAN pnl/ct is still pinned to ev_per_ct via the uncapped fires' slack.
exec_price.source: wx_scaling_schedule.md depth-bind-point analysis (median exec $0.89); kalshi_weather_expand_summary.json KXLOW mean exec 0.977

fires_per_day.note: All-cities/rungs pooled, admissible fires including the full locked_orders() stackable set (i.e. stacking is already baked into this baseline -- see stacking sleeve below for how the model handles turning it OFF). UNRECONCILED SOURCES IN THIS REPO (judge review finding #5): wx_ev_concentration.md all-families backtest mean=25.7/day (used for the $/mo capacity arithmetic below); wx_scaling_schedule.md's own gate-ETA math uses 10.4/day (gate_basis_rate_per_day, exposed here and used for a sensitivity check in wx_path_to_4k.py's output and in PATH_TO_4K.md's Stage 0-2 ETAs); phase2_tier1 cites 58.95/day; the KXHIGH-only cut of kalshi_weather_expand_summary.json cites 4.39/WEEK (flagged unreconciled in that file itself). These are not reconciled to each other in this repo. The capacity model's headline $/mo bands use 25.7/day; a SENSITIVITY row at the gate-basis 10.4/day is printed separately so the gap is visible rather than silently resolved to the favorable rate. random.triangular(low, high, mode) takes MODE as its third argument, not mean; the model now derives mode = 3*mean - min - max analytically so the simulated distribution's mean matches the stated mean field exactly, instead of passing mean where mode was expected (judge review finding #10).

unfillable_frac.quality: BACKTEST (0.21) / ASSUMED (0.10 interpolated, 0.0 is a n=33/1-day point estimate not a robust rate); conservative_live is MEASURED live tonight (0 fills / 39 near-misses, Wilson95 upper bound on the fillable rate ~9% -> unfillable ~0.91), not backtest-derived
unfillable_frac.note: Fraction of admissible fires with no executable book at fire time -- skipped entirely regardless of bankroll. conservative_live exists because the 'conservative, horizon 0' scenario's 0.21 unfillable_frac is a BACKTEST number that live evidence to date does not support: tonight's book_watch near-miss log shows 0 fires out of 39 near-misses, all logged ask>98 (repriced before capture). Report both; do not present conservative-scenario dollars without also showing the live-consistent number.

depth_at_or_below_98c_ct.note: Full sorted empirical array, computed directly from wx_book_snapshots.jsonl this session (field depth_at_or_below_98c). p25=72 p50=369.5 p75=999 mean=736.9 -- median real depth is ~15x the deployed DEPTH_CAP=25 constant, but the bottom decile (p10=6) is thinner than 25, so the fixed cap is not uniformly conservative. Sampled by bootstrap (random.choice) per simulated fire so the model uses the REAL distribution, not a point estimate. CAVEAT (judge review finding #8): n=86 rows are 3 sweeps of ~29 distinct markets on 1 calendar day -- effective independent n is closer to 29 (markets), or 1 (calendar days), not 86. The bootstrap (random.choice) draws are NOT independent across a simulated month the way iid sampling implies, and same-day fires share whatever drove that day's book depth. This sample additionally requires >=15 distinct calendar days before the repo's own depth_adaptive gate opens (see sleeves.depth_adaptive) -- Stage-5 $/mo figures that depend on depth_adaptive should be read as PENDING that 15-day sample, the same way Polymarket figures are excluded pending its own study.

sizing.quality: ASSUMED (all are repo constants/config, not measured outcomes)

taker_mechanical.label: taker mechanical (core edge)
taker_mechanical.quality: BACKTEST edge / MEASURED live infra state
taker_mechanical.note: Always active at any modeled bankroll >= $10. This is the base sleeve every other lever multiplies or adds to.

stacking.label: rung stacking (fire full locked_orders() set)
stacking.note: fires_per_day above is ALREADY the full-stack (deployed) rate. If 'stacking' is excluded from the active sleeve set, the model derates fires_per_day by rank1_only_capacity_share=0.631 to show what capacity looks like WITHOUT it.

station_derate_relax.label: per-station derate relaxation (KMIA/KLAX/KPHL/KSEA)
station_derate_relax.status: DEPLOYED (verified 2026-07-20: kwx_runner.py recalibration of 2026-07-18 already removed KLAX/KMIA/KPHL/KSEA derates; only KPHX retains 0.5x size mult)
station_derate_relax.quality: BACKTEST (validation) / MEASURED (deploy state read from live kwx_runner.py STATION_SIZE_MULT)
station_derate_relax.note: ACTIVE in all horizons: the relaxation is live code, not a pending config change. +8% aggregate size proxy retained from the study.

book_watch.label: book-watch transient-ask capture
book_watch.status: MEASURED NULL (2026-07-20 diagnosis, WX_NEARMISS_DIAGNOSIS.md): near-misses are not convertible opportunities
book_watch.note: DO NOT MODEL AS A LEVER. Candlestick replay of all 52 near-misses: market no_ask crossed 98c a median 106 min BEFORE the margin+sustain lock rule confirmed (10/10 sampled) -- the capture window closes before any feasible feed can see it. 62% of logged near-misses trace to a one-time 20h39m leg outage (fixed); continuous-era detection latency is ~8min (feed-bound). Watcher stays deployed as a costless residual catcher, but its assumed 7.8/day conversion is refuted; expected attributed fires ~0. Near-miss count is a market-efficiency observation, not a pipeline leak.
book_watch.source: WX_NEARMISS_DIAGNOSIS.md (52/52 rows reconstructed against production feeds)

early_lock.label: early-lock pre-positioning
early_lock.status: HISTORICAL NULL per wx_earlylock_deep_study (2026-07-20): 5,415 matched rows, no cell clears Bonferroni, headline cell sign-flips across halves; forward paper harness continues but prior is now ~zero
early_lock.note: DO NOT MODEL AS A LEVER. wx_earlylock_deep_study.md: EV statistically indistinguishable from zero over 2,031 station-days after fixing the outcome-truth bug; best |t| 0.3-1.6 vs ~3.11 Bonferroni bar. The forward paper harness stays running (costless) but the n=30 forward gate would need to overcome this null prior, so no capacity credit until it actually PASSES.
early_lock.source: wx_earlylock_deep_study.md / wx_earlylock_deep_data.json (panel: no decision-grade positive cell)

maker.label: maker resting bids
maker.status: REFUTED by wx_maker_deep_study (2026-07-20): naive +7c/ct headline collapses to 2-3 genuine maker fills in 65d x 20 stations under marketability audit
maker.note: DO NOT MODEL AS A LEVER. wx_maker_deep_study.md: post-lock resting bids convert ~0.03-0.05 genuine fills/day system-wide (economically negligible); pre-lock arm confirmed-negative by sign. Reopen only per the staged gate in that study (corrected post-only simulator, n>=30 genuine fills).

depth_adaptive.label: depth-adaptive sizing (relax fixed DEPTH_CAP=25)
depth_adaptive.status: IN-VALIDATION, explicit 'do not adopt yet' in repo
depth_adaptive.note: Pre-registered bar also requires >=300 rows and station-median stability <2x sweep-to-sweep; row-count clears fast at the new cadence, so distinct-days is modeled as the binding sub-gate. When gate passes AND this sleeve is requested, per-fire cap becomes depth_adaptive_alpha * (bootstrap real depth sample) instead of the fixed depth_cap_deployed_ct.

added_markets_polymarket.label: added markets (Polymarket cross-venue)
added_markets_polymarket.status: SPECULATIVE, one unvalidated candidate found; Kalshi-side scan already exhausted/null
added_markets_polymarket.note: accrual_per_day=null -> this gate is NOT time-accruable in the model (a real study with unknown duration must run first, not just elapsed calendar time) -- it never auto-passes in conservative/base/optimistic horizons here. Reported separately as a labeled stretch case, excluded from the headline curve.

bankroll_rungs.name: Rung1
bankroll_rungs.note: $10 canary is live (KWX_SWITCH=on) but zero fires have actually fired yet (kwx_runner_state.json fired={}).

bankroll_rungs.name: Rung3
bankroll_rungs.note: Gated on a policy decision (depth_adaptive sleeve), not a fire count.

conservative_live._note: Same sleeves/horizon as conservative, but unfillable_frac forced to the live-observed 0/39 rate instead of the 0.21 backtest rate. Judge review finding #4.

depth_fire_conditional_ct.note: depth_at_or_below_98c_ct above is the UNCONDITIONAL pooled book depth (all rungs, including deep-ITM ones a fire never touches). This block is the fire-relevant near-lock/touch-price depth instead: depth_within_2c and best_ask_size from the two largest-n station/day blocks in kalshi_weather_orderbook_summary.json's depth_report (n=58 and n=37 respectively, out of 14 blocks whose medians range 11-25389 with small unstable n elsewhere -- these two are the most reliable). Judge review flagged that gating depth_adaptive on the pooled 98c-or-below array (median 369.5) instead of this fire-conditional one overstates reachable size by ~5x. The model now takes min(alpha * pooled_bootstrap_sample, alpha * depth_within_2c_median_ct) per fire -- the pessimistic of the two gates the plan, per judge instruction.
depth_fire_conditional_ct.source: kalshi_weather_orderbook_summary.json depth_report (this session); judge review finding #1

market_impact.note: The repo's own Q2 depth-adaptive study measured EV/ct haircut from $196.66 (naive) to $165.18 (mean order 236ct, realistic-fill) -- a 16% impact/slippage haircut at that order size. wx_path_to_4k.py previously applied the flat backtest EV/ct at ANY order size up to int(0.25*max_bankroll_grid), 6-10x the study's mean order with zero impact term. The model now scales a per-fire EV haircut linearly with order size relative to this reference (impact_frac = min(cap_frac, reference_haircut_frac * n_ct/reference_order_ct)), applied to that fire's realized EV/ct before the win/loss split so both mean and variance shrink for large orders.

param_uncertainty.quality: ASSUMED (half-widths sized off the Wilson95 CI language already in win_rate.note and the BACKTEST-range spread already in ev_per_ct_usd.note -- e.g. win_rate note cites Wilson95 LB ~99.2-99.4% vs point 99.4-99.6%, ev_per_ct note cites +0.15-0.17 realistic-latency vs +0.207 in-sample ceiling)
param_uncertainty.note: win_rate, ev_per_ct, and unfillable_frac are now redrawn ONCE PER TRIAL (one simulated month) from Uniform(point-halfwidth, point+halfwidth), clipped to valid ranges, instead of held fixed at the point value for all 1500 trials. This makes p10/p90 reflect genuine input uncertainty, not just Bernoulli win/loss and Poisson-ish fire-count sampling noise at a single fixed input. Previously bands were pure within-scenario sampling noise despite code comments and this file's _readme claiming inputs got 'a wide uncertainty multiplier' -- judge review finding #3.
